adaptations: Private temporary roots are random and mode0700; native fixture files are0600. No original assertion depends on permission bits; contents, names, links and operation order match.

JavaScript Number maps to exact native f64 comparisons where parsed legacy schema and percentile outputs use floating representation. No numeric tolerance, rounding or changed expected value. The first two author failures preserve the strict serde representation mismatch.

Source regexes for literal human output are checked as exact substring containment, preserving case, punctuation and whitespace; source string-includes and scalar-count assertions retain those meanings.
NoSecrets rejects any native Keychain access. All saved configuration is confined to each synthetic fixture; inactive invalid evaluator settings are preserved.
Native target preservation adds an exact byte equality check beyond the source substring assertion.
limits: Target/fixture assertions cannot prove no operating-system read syscall; they prove rejected API behavior and unchanged target content, consistent with source scope.
The one-entry directory-scan test asserts truncation only, matching source; no unspecified directory iteration order is normalized into a stronger equivalence claim.
Capture counts source assertions; it does not fabricate native outputs or replace original assertion predicates.
Focused checks bind relevant inputs and copied test executables, not a complete workspace build-input/provenance freeze.
